label: Claude Sonnet 5.5
output:
Some good news, and some honesty.

Priya Bhatia joins us on Monday 16 November. She's a chartered engineer (IStructE) and spent nine years at a consultancy in Coventry. If you see her on site, please say hello. We're really glad to have her.

Now the honest part. In September and October, beam calculations and drawings were taking 5 to 6 weeks to reach you. That is far too long. One couple had their builder standing waiting with the steel already ordered, and we only got it to them in 3 days after they'd chased us twice. A few of you were quite unhappy, and one review was sharp. It was fair.

The slow weeks were my fault. I said yes to too much work on my own, doing site visits in the day and calculations until midnight. My wife started calling the office "the other house". That wasn't good for you or for me.

Priya is how we fix it. Our target for beam calcs and drawings is now 10 working days, and we intend to hold ourselves to it.

If you're waiting on something from us right now, your job is moving. Message me directly and I'll tell you exactly where it is.

One other change. From 1 January 2027, first site visits will cost £95. If you go ahead with us, that £95 is deducted from your fee. We've found that about a third of free visits never turn into a job, and that's time I can't give to the people already waiting on us. Any visit already booked by the time this post goes up stays free, whatever date it's on.

Thank you to everyone who stuck with us through a rough couple of months. I'm genuinely happy about where we're heading, and I'd rather you hold us to it than take my word for it.
